text: {"lessons":["A stock’s gain or loss relative to my purchase price is not a reason by itself to buy or sell; each position is part of one portfolio.","Past price movements do not predict future movements, so I should avoid reacting impulsively to short-term declines or rebounds.","I have made no trades so far; I should review the whole portfolio periodically and trade only when there is a reason, while respecting my cash and share limits."]}
